name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP cuts Sudan and Gaza aid; no full suspension
summary: WFP says 900,000 people in Sudan have lost food aid over funding cuts and it has ended monthly aid to 500,000 in Gaza
state: WFP said on 12 Nov that funding shortfalls cut the number it reaches in Sudan from over 4 million in August to just over 3 million, leaving about 900,000 without food aid, and that it needs $520 million through April 2027 (Darfur24). WFP said in Oct that a shortfall would end monthly aid to 500,000 people in Gaza (Khaleej Times, citing AFP). Major ration cuts meet Watch; no large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country was found as of 19 Nov.
for_you: People in Sudan and Gaza who rely on food aid are most exposed to these cuts. The OCHA Financial Tracking Service publishes official appeal funding figures.
rubric_hit: Major ration cuts: WFP aid in Sudan cut from 4m to 3m people, 900,000 lose aid (Watch); no large-scale suspension found

sources.title: Darfur24 — WFP cuts aid to 900,000 people in Sudan
Khaleej Times — UN World Food Programme to end monthly aid to 500,000 in Gaza

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
